## 0.1.0-beta.17

- Send a report now includes the outcome of each advertised server connection: local, remote, or relay; HTTP or HTTPS; and failure reasons such as DNS lookup, timeout, certificate verification, or an HTTP status. The new diagnostics contain no server addresses, server names, or sign-in tokens.
- The report also records how many connections Plex supplied and which connection was selected. Connection selection is unchanged; this update gathers evidence for connection failures, including issue #13, rather than claiming to fix them.
- Help explains how to troubleshoot blocks from other frames during server video conversion.
- Removed an unnecessary instruction from the update progress screen.

To report a connection problem, reproduce it after updating, then open Options > Send a report and share the displayed report code in your support issue. You can reach Options with Back from the sign-in screen.

Validation: public and supporter build checks, Linux tests, ARM vet/build, and report redaction tests. No new MiSTer hardware or CRT/HDMI smoke test was performed for this diagnostics update.
